sections.title: Mandatory Disclosures
sections.content: Sir/Madam, This has a reference to APH Clause 7.38 wherein Mandatory Disclosures as per Annexure – 10 shall be displayed in the website of each Technical Institute. Display of information submitted to AICTE (including the accreditation status and Board of Governors) along with mandatory disclosures in the Website of the Institution is essential as per APH 2020-21. This Office has randomly checked for the same and found Mandatory Disclosure of Old Version or not able to trace on the website of the various institutions. Hence, this is to inform all Technical Institutions under SCRO Hyderabad to adhere with the norms & regulations of the AICTE and the compliance may be reverted back within 10 days. 2025-2026 View 2024-2025 View 2023-2024 View 2022-2023 View 2021-2022 View 2020-2021 View 2019-2020 View 2018-2019 View 2017-2018 View 2016-2017 View 2015-2016 View 2014-2015 View 2013-2014 View 2012-2013 View 2011-2012 View 2010-2011 View 2009-2010 View 2008-2009 View 2007-2008 View 2006-2007 View 2005-2006 View 2004-2005 View 2003-2004 View 2002-2003 View Letter of Intent FROM AICTE View LOI Establishment of Institutions View Autonomous Approval UGC View Autonomous Conferment Letter – JNTUH View HIGHER EDUCATION(TE)DEPARTMENT – 2015 View HIGHER EDUCATION(TE)DEPARTMENT – 2013 View HIGHER EDUCATION(TE)DEPARTMENT – 2012 View HIGHER EDUCATION(TE)DEPARTMENT – 2011 View Affiliation View
